authorityAndLimits.zeroEffectBasis: The only generation effect port installed by the self-corpus command is the in-process scripted responder. The reader invokes only local git cat-file/ls-tree; the command imports no network/provider adapter. These zeros describe that constructed path, not a universal instrumented count for other processes.
